description: Additive migration (Product.sku nullable unique, Variant.costPrice nullable Int) and admin-only purchase price end to end: VariantService/DTO accept costPrice, the product editor's 'Variants, price & stock' table shows and edits 'Purchase (₹)', variant-slabs.tsx stops wiping non-Size/Color attributes, storefront DTOs proven not to leak costPrice, plus round-3 NIT 2 (editor/wizard variant SKU may not equal another product's saved Parent SKU). Independent of FEAT-002. Design refs: design.md §2, §5 (VariantUpsertDto costPrice), §8, §9, §11 (variant.service / product.service / cart / variant-edit specs); design-review.md finding 2.
steps: Schema: in apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma add to model Product `sku String? @unique` (comment: parent SKU from the bulk sheet; null for legacy products) and to model Variant `costPrice Int?` (comment: purchase price, paise; ADMIN-ONLY). Leave isTaxInclusive untouched.

Migration: create apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261002120000_product_sku_variant_cost_price/migration.sql with EXACTLY: `-- Purchase (cost) price per variant, paise. Admin-only; nullable, no default.` / `ALTER TABLE "variants" ADD COLUMN "costPrice" INTEGER;` / `-- Parent SKU used by the bulk Excel sheet. Nullable; Postgres UNIQUE allows many NULLs.` / `ALTER TABLE "products" ADD COLUMN "sku" TEXT;` / `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "products_sku_key" ON "products"("sku");`. Then run `pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:generate`.

API VariantService.upsert (apps/api/src/modules/catalogue/variant.service.ts): input gains `costPrice?: number | null`; update data adds `...(input.costPrice !== undefined ? { costPrice: input.costPrice } : {})`; create data adds `costPrice: input.costPrice ?? null`. No MRP check on costPrice. NIT 2: after the existing variant SKU clash check, `const owner = await this.prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { sku: input.sku }, select: { id: true, title: true } })`; if owner && owner.id !== input.productId throw `new ConflictException(`SKU "${input.sku}" is the Parent SKU of "${owner.title}" — use a different SKU`)`.

API specs: variant.service.spec.ts — extend the build() fake with `product: { findUnique: async () => null }` (and a variant that lets a test return an owner), add cases: costPrice undefined -> update data has no costPrice key; null -> costPrice null; number -> set; create defaults costPrice null; NIT 2 conflict when product.findUnique returns another product (409 with the exact message, no create/update), no conflict when it returns input.productId. product.service.spec.ts — new describe for §9 confidentiality: ProductService.detail() and list() against a fake whose variant has `costPrice: 12345`; assert `JSON.stringify(dto)` contains neither 'costPrice' nor '12345' (build the fake modelled on the existing list/ids specs; read ProductService.detail/list for the exact queries). cart.service.spec.ts — add one assertion that a cart line has no costPrice key (fake variant carries costPrice).

Web apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.ts per design §8: AdminVariantRow.costPrice: number | null; VariantEdit.cost: string (initialEdit -> costPrice == null ? '' : toRupees(costPrice)); validateEdits: non-blank cost that is not money -> `${sku}: enter a valid purchase price (0 or more), or leave it blank.`; VariantUpsertBody.costPrice: number | null; variantUpsertBody: cost blank -> null else toPaise; a cost-only change is a change; body always carries costPrice. Add exported `pickAttr(attrs, ...keys): string` (trimmed value of the first entry whose k.toLowerCase() is in keys, else '') and make variantLabel use it (same behaviour). Add exported `mergeVariantAttrs(existing, size, color)`: keep every key except Size/Color/Colour (case-insensitive), then set trimmed non-blank Size and Color.

Web apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/product-editor.tsx: add a 'Purchase (₹)' <th scope="col"> between 'Selling (₹)' and 'Stock' and a matching cell: <input type="number" step={0.01} min={0} placeholder="optional" value={e.cost} aria-label={`Purchase price in rupees for ${v.sku}`} onChange -> updEdit(v.id, { cost }) data-testid={`editor-v-cost-${i}`}/> following the existing MRP/Selling inputs' className/markup. Append to the section hint: 'Purchase price is for your records only — customers never see it.' No other save-flow change.

Web apps/web/src/app/admin/catalogue/variant-slabs.tsx: in reload() read `size: pickAttr(attrs, 'size')`, `color: pickAttr(attrs, 'color', 'colour')`; in save(v) send `attributes: mergeVariantAttrs(v.attributesJson, vm.size, vm.color)` instead of buildAttrs(...). addVariant keeps buildAttrs. Do not send costPrice from here (undefined = unchanged).

Web tests apps/web/src/lib/variant-edit.test.ts: cost in initialEdit/validateEdits/variantUpsertBody (cost-only change returns a body; blank -> null); mergeVariantAttrs keeps 'Pack Of'; pickAttr({ size: 'M ' }, 'size') === 'M'; pickAttr({ Colour: 'Red' }, 'color', 'colour') === 'Red'; mergeVariantAttrs({ size: 'M', 'Pack Of': '2' }, pickAttr({ size: 'M' }, 'size'), '') -> { Size: 'M', 'Pack Of': '2' }; existing variantLabel tests still pass. Update any existing fixtures of AdminVariantRow/VariantEdit for the new fields.
Optional local DB: if DATABASE_URL points at localhost and Postgres is reachable, run `pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:migrate`; otherwise skip and record that in findings.

Commit (stage by explicit path, see context.json rules: the migration.sql is new so stage it; schema.prisma is pre-existing untracked so do NOT stage it — list it in the commit body as 'also changed (untracked): apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma'): `feat(catalogue): add Product.sku + admin-only Variant.costPrice and purchase price in the product editor`.
acceptance_criteria: migration.sql exists at apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261002120000_product_sku_variant_cost_price/ with exactly the 3 SQL statements; schema.prisma has Product.sku String? @unique and Variant.costPrice Int?; prisma generate succeeds
pnpm --filter @belzo/api test passes including the new costPrice, NIT-2 and confidentiality specs (AC-12 detail DTO has no costPrice)
pnpm --filter @belzo/web test passes including the new variant-edit specs
The editor shows 'Purchase (₹)' per variant (AC-13); saving other fields keeps slabs, attributes, weight and image
api and web typecheck + lint pass
findings: Commit 0d29c3c on master (local, not pushed). Verification all PASS: api db:generate OK (no EPERM); shared build OK; api typecheck OK; api test 24 suites / 192 tests pass; api lint clean; web typecheck OK; web test 5 suites / 61 tests pass; web lint 0 errors (4 pre-existing /useMemo warnings in unrelated files). MIGRATION NOT APPLIED LOCALLY: DATABASE_URL is localhost:5433 but Postgres was unreachable (TCP test failed), so db:migrate was skipped; it must be applied on deploy (scripts/deploy.ps1 does not run migrations). schema.prisma is untracked and NOT committed (listed in commit body); note the whole apps/api/prisma/migrations/ dir is untracked, only the new 20261002120000_product_sku_variant_cost_price/migration.sql was staged. Prisma client now has Product.sku (String? @unique, placed after attributesJson) and Variant.costPrice (Int?, after weightGrams). For later FEATs: VariantService.upsert now calls this.prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { sku }, select: { id, title } }) after the variant-SKU clash check (NIT 2), so any fake Prisma that reaches past the clash check in upsert needs product.findUnique; variant.service.spec build(existing, products) takes an optional FakeProduct[] ({id,title,sku}). variant-edit.ts exports pickAttr(attrs, ...keys) and mergeVariantAttrs(existing, size, color) (keeps non Size/Color/Colour keys, writes canonical Size/Color). VariantUpsertBody always carries costPrice (number|null); variant-slabs.tsx and product-wizard.tsx do not send costPrice (undefined = unchanged). product.service.spec has a new 'storefront DTOs — costPrice confidentiality' describe (detail + list paginated/ids); toExportRows/exportRows specs untouched (FEAT-003 removes them). Nothing unexpected.
